messages:
mike_cs: quick heads-up — did three onboarding calls this morning (ParkCo, HelioHealth, NorthBay). saw the same 3 asks crop up across accounts. dropping raw notes here. can we standardize a 1-pager/template so CS can paste directly into the product tracker? tagging for renewal-risk follow-up @rachel_pm @sam_pd :point_up:
rachel_pm: yes please paste the notes here and mark any accounts you think are at risk. short bullets ok — we can expand in the tracker later.
mike_cs: raw notes:
```
- ParkCo (acct: PARK-342): "we can't see per-route cost breakdown; finance can't reconcile charges" — asks per-route token cost + export (P1, renewal flagged)
- HelioHealth (acct: HEL-771): embedding onboarding stuck; random zero embeddings for some uploads; wants clearer embedding checklist + sample data (P2)
- NorthBay (acct: NB-119): wants per-account token caps and alerting during pilot; worried about overages (P1, trial-to-paid in 3 weeks)
```
anya_support: nit — when capturing, also include whether customer would accept a temporary workaround (doc + quota tweak). saves engineering time and helps renewals.
sam_pd: suggested quick template for CS paste (one-line each):
```
problem: <one line problem statement>
signal: <how often/where we see it; logs or customer report>
impact: <business/renewal impact estimate>
workaround: <possible temporary fix customer will accept>
urgency: P1/P2/P3 + renewal impact Y/N
quote: "customer quote here"
```
feedback-bot: new items added to Feedback Queue (3) — tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/feedback-board (auto-tag: onboarding-cs).
rachel_pm: i'll triage and tag with severity + area. quick read: ParkCo & NorthBay sound like high priority for renewals. sam, can Optimize provide any fast config suggestions for per-route visibility or quotas?
sam_pd: short-term: we can add a per-route token export to the billing CSV (1 sprint) and a docs section for per-account caps + alerting (doc only). per-route dashboard will be 2 sprints.
mike_cs: perfect. i'll add the customer quotes and mark the two renewal-risk accounts in the tracker. can we also include a one-line 'how this affects ROI' for execs? helps renewal conversations.
rachel_pm: yes — i'll add ROI blurb while triaging this afternoon. thx everyone. :thumbsup:
